core_obligations: Write the presheaf map: the proof writes down, on each open, the same combination of free modules over the rings of sections that defines the sheaf level map (proof lines 5061-5069)
Identify the values: the cokernel of that presheaf map on an open is the module of differentials of the corresponding map of rings, by the algebraic construction (proof lines 5070-5072)
Sheafify: the sheaves appearing in the sheaf level map are the sheafifications of the presheaves written down, so the statement follows from exactness of sheafification (proof lines 5073-5075)
proof_roadmap: 该映射在 U 上的余核按定义就是 Ω_{O_2(U)/O_1(U)}（跨章定义）；而层版本中各自由层正是这些预层的层化，层化正合，故 Ω_{O_2/O_1} 就是该预层的层化。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the universal module of differentials of a homomorphism of sheaves of rings with the sheaf associated to the presheaf assigning to an open the module of differentials of the corresponding rings of sections (author lemma at source lines 5052-5058, label lemma-differentials-sheafify). The proof (source lines 5060-5076) writes down the presheaf analogue of the defining map, identifies its cokernel on an open with the algebraic module of differentials, and concludes because the sheaves appearing in the defining map are the sheafifications of those presheaves and sheafification is exact (proof lines 5061-5075). The comparison of the two constructions is the content; the defining map is reproduced as a context span. H2.
